scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @mt/shared && npm run db:generate -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,client,server -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @mt/shared" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mt/shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate -w server -- --name init && npm run db:seed -w server
